install.windows_download: Open https://cursor.com/download in the browser, click the Windows installer. Saves to %USERPROFILE%\Downloads by default.
install.macos_download: Open https://cursor.com/download in the browser, click the macOS download (.dmg). Saves to ~/Downloads by default.
install.linux_download: Open https://cursor.com/download and select the .deb, .rpm, or AppImage for x64 or ARM64. Install a downloaded .deb with apt or .rpm with the distro package manager. For AppImage, save under ~/Applications, make it executable, and run it.
install.note: GUI IDE. AI features and model selection are built into the app; EchoBird does not switch its model. EchoBird supports multiple accounts in the default user-data directory on Windows, macOS and Linux. Launch Cursor once to initialize its database and system credential store. On Linux, save your work and close Cursor before switching; on Windows/macOS, EchoBird requests a normal quit and aborts if the editor remains open. The system keychain/keyring must be accessible.

identity_guard.description: This reference installs the Cursor desktop editor, not Cursor CLI or Grok Build. Do not install CLI unless explicitly requested.
identity_guard.update: Use Cursor: Attempt Update inside the desktop editor. agent update does not update the editor and can execute Grok Build instead.
identity_guard.windows_user_setup: A user-level Cursor installation disables updates when run as administrator. Verify the launch permission and updater log; do not move its executable path to another product.

install_flow.summary: winget if available → otherwise download installer → user runs the wizard or AppImage
agent_steps: Windows: prefer `winget install --id Anysphere.Cursor` if winget is available — silent install.
Manual fallback: download the installer to the user's Downloads folder using `Invoke-WebRequest` (Windows) or `curl -L -o` (macOS/Linux).
After download finishes, tell the user the EXACT file path.
Open the installer (`Start-Process` on Windows, `open` on macOS).

Linux AppImage: save it under ~/Applications and make it executable. Register a per-user ~/.local/share/applications/cursor.desktop entry with Type=Application, Name=Cursor and Exec pointing to the absolute AppImage path (quote and escape paths containing spaces). Preserve an existing valid entry. Refresh EchoBird detection and verify that it resolves the same executable; downloading the AppImage alone is not a complete installation.
Tell the user: 'Cursor 安装向导已打开,请按向导点击下一步完成安装。' / 'The Cursor installer is open — follow the wizard to finish.'
Do NOT try to automate the GUI wizard.
tell_user: That the installer was opened or that winget is installing silently
That Cursor handles its own model selection — Echobird does NOT switch models for it
